label: Intent-To-Treat Population Flag
derivation: Copy; only ITTFL = "Y" patients are in ADTTE

label: Analysis Date
derivation: PFS: first of progression and death; if neither, the censoring date (SAP section 6.1). OS: death date, else last date known alive

label: Event or Censoring Description
derivation: Which event or censoring rule gave ADT, for example "Disease progression"

label: Censor Date Description
derivation: Which date was used to censor, for example "Last adequate tumor assessment"

label: Source Data
derivation: Dataset that gave ADT: ADRS or ADSL

label: Source Variable
derivation: Variable that gave ADT, for example ADT, DTHDT

label: Source Sequence Number
derivation: ASEQ of the ADRS record that gave ADT (empty for ADSL)
